introHtml: Yoga practitioners need headbands and wristbands that stay put through downward dog and sweat-wicking to keep them dry. Our custom yoga headbands and wristbands are made from moisture-wicking materials like microfiber and terry cloth, with no-slip silicone grips to prevent shifting during practice. Whether you're branding gear for a yoga studio, a corporate wellness event, or a charity yoga fundraiser, these accessories keep your logo visible and functional. Choose from solid colors or tie-dye patterns, and add your imprint via screen printing or debossing.
